list: A dark floral carpet, embroidered with pale pistils. The five petals represent the five young ladies who broke from the Castle of Dreams' confinement, and their unyielding hearts that refused the call of fantasy.
A painting within a wooden frame, depicting a moonlit night wrapped in chains. Every visitor has chains lashing down their spirit, chains unique to them. Only those of resolute will can break free.
A panoramic display showing the Castle of Dreams' concert area, the scene outside the latticed windows seemingly-eternal night. No night lasts forever, no dream never ends.
Flooring unique to the Castle of Dreams, the dark stone tiles inlaid with conspicuous goldwork. As they left, the dreamseekers' footsteps atop these tiles were more confident than when they arrived.
theme: A room replicating the Castle of Dreams after some strange changes. Though all who walk into the Castle see its environs slightly differently, the marks left behind by the dreamseekers will last forevermore upon this scene.

list: During the Somniloquium Serenum event, obtain Operators Umiri Yahata and Nyamu Yūtenji

That your precious companions have returned to your side is owed entirely to your efforts.
No matter how many times you part, you will always become one again.
During the Somniloquium Serenum event, complete all stages in [Somniamus Omnes] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials and story stages)

The songs and the screams from their souls, the instruments of their final concert, are forever bound to linger in your mind.
Stranger to you that some of their tribulations may be, you know their determination is made, their die cast, and they will stand and face the music. As will you one day, surely.
